name: BLACKMIND: Psychic Social Simulator
source:
A man is currently loading bullets into a gun. Tonight's murder won't be his first, and he doesn't intend it to be his last. Nobody knows who he is, or how to catch him.

Elsewhere, a different man has just been released from police custody. The police correctly identified him as a pickpocket, but missed that he is a psychic, with the ability to read and overwrite minds, as well as see into the future.

His abilities haven't shown him that he has an upcoming encounter with the killer - one which will change the course of his life dramatically…

[From [url=https://toomanyteethstudios.itch.io/blackmind-psychic-social-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名男子正在往枪膛里装填子弹。今晚的谋杀绝非他的第一次作案，他也丝毫没打算就此收手。无人知晓他的真实身份，更没人知道该如何将他绳之以法。

与此同时，在城市的另一头，另一名男子刚刚从警局获释。警方准确识破了他扒手的身份，却漏掉了他是一名超能力者的事实——他不仅能够读取并篡改他人记忆，还能预见未来。

然而他的超能力却未能向他预示：他即将与那名连环杀手迎面相遇——而这场遭遇，将彻底改写他的人生轨迹……

[摘自[url=https://toomanyteethstudios.itch.io/blackmind-psychic-social-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
